text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Duramente conquered the Takarazuka Kinen. 
Her overwhelming display of power raises 
the crowd's expectations that she truly 
has what it takes to conquer the world.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Her strength was so overwhelming that the 
Umamusume who ran alongside her felt a 
fierce desire to surpass her.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Duramente herself once again realized the 
high level of racing in Japan. She vowed 
to become an Umamusume worthy of 
representing this nation—

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
She declared her challenge for the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn), wishing to attain the 
prestige befitting the strongest.
